summary.text: Amanda Potter is the Democratic candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A marketing manager, she is a former public school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Potter graduated from Underwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Jamestown in 2001, and earned a graduate degree from Sioux Falls Seminary in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in rural North Dakota, taught in public schools for three years, and then moved to Sioux Falls for a Master of Divinity.
She said she worked in marketing and communications at Volunteers of America Dakotas and Midco before joining Sanford Health, where she is manager of content strategy.
Potter said she has been involved with Lunch Is Served, Inc. and the Sioux Falls Public Schools Education Foundation.

Potter named education, healthcare access and cost of living as her key campaign messages, including fully funding public schools, expanding early childhood education and supporting rural hospitals and clinics.
